item.title: UK blocks entry for Swedish scholar over Palestine speaking engagement
item.description: British authorities revoked travel permission for academic Andreas Malm, citing that his arrival would fail to benefit the public interest. The decision follows his scheduled participation in a Palestine-related conference.

item.description: দীর্ঘ অভিনয় জীবনে প্রায় আড়াই শ চলচ্চিত্রে কাজ করলেও অভিনেতা পরেশ রাওয়াল নিজের অভিনীত মাত্র এগারোটি ছবিকে পছন্দ করেছেন। সম্প্রতি এক সাক্ষাৎকারে তিনি এই তথ্য জানান।

item.title: Spanish train crash survivors demand safety upgrades after fresh tragedy
item.description: Following a recent rail accident, survivors dealing with psychological trauma are pressing authorities for immediate action. Specialists are urging increased funding for railway safety measures to prevent further tragedies.

item.title: তাহসিফের নদীতে ঝাঁপ দেওয়ার বিষয়ে জিজ্ঞাসাবাদে যা বলেছেন দীপ
item.description: জিজ্ঞাসাবাদে দীপ জানিয়েছেন, কিছু লোক ধাওয়া করায় তাহসিফ নদীতে ঝাঁপ দেয় এবং তিনি নিজে সেখান থেকে পালিয়ে আসেন। পিবিআই জানিয়েছে, ঘটনার তদন্তের অংশق গত বৃহস্পতিবার রাতে মাজার বস্তি এলাকা থেকে একটি মোটরসাইকেল উদ্ধার করা হয়েছে।

item.description: As reported by ESPNcricinfo, Roston Chase was unbeaten on 43 and Chanderpaul scored a patient 56 as WI folded for 245. Key points: Nayeem, Bangladesh, Roston Chase, Chanderpaul.

item.title: US midterms: 4 days to go – What the polls say as Trump cancels two rallies
item.description: As reported by Al Jazeera, Trump cancels Kansas and Iowa rallies, opting for telephone events across nearly 20 states over the weekend. Key points: What, Trump, Kansas, Iowa.

item.title: Ex-Legislator Muthukumar Turns Himself In Amid Bribery Probe
item.description: Following the Supreme Court's rejection of his pre-arrest bail request on Wednesday, former MLA Muthukumar turned himself in to authorities on Thursday morning in connection with a corruption case involving former Minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi.

item.title: Stalin Seeks Apology Over Academic's Detention While TVK Denies Bias
item.description: Stalin has demanded an apology from Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay regarding the police custody of a MIDS professor. Meanwhile, the TVK party rejected allegations of political motivation, stating the questioning was unrelated to the academic's comments on rice prices.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Postpones Rural Elections to November 5
item.description: The State Election Commission rescheduled MPTC and ZPTC elections to November 5 due to staffing shortages for simultaneous vote counting, while municipal elections remain scheduled for November 1 despite cyclone concerns.

item.title: Enforcement Directorate Raids Eight Locations in West Bengal
item.description: Authorities searched eight properties across West Bengal concerning the alleged abuse of bankruptcy laws. The investigation involves financial institutions, Kohinoor Power, and other entities, according to officials.

item.title: MIDS Researcher Meets Tamil Nadu Chief Minister After Release
item.description: Academic Kalaiyarasan met with Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay at the Secretariat on Thursday and stated that the Chief Minister accepted responsibility and expressed remorse twice over the incident, emphasizing the need to respect constitutional principles.

item.title: ট্রাম্প নেতানিয়াহুর রাজনৈতিক সাফল্যের প্রশংসা করেছেন
item.description: ইসরায়েলের প্রধানমন্ত্রী বেনিয়ামিন নেতানিয়াহুর সাম্প্রতিক রাজনৈতিক কার্যক্রমে ডোনাল্ড ট্রাম্প সন্তোষ প্রকাশ করেছেন। বিরোধীরা সরকার গড়তে ব্যর্থ হলে নেতানিয়াহু জাতীয় ঐক্যের প্রশাসন গঠনের সুযোগ পেতে পারেন।

item.title: Kishan Returns as India Adjusts Lineup for Fourth T20I
item.description: Recovered from injury, Ishan Kishan replaced Vaibhav Sooryavanshi for the fourth T20 match. Additionally, India swapped out veteran fast bowler Bhuvneshwar Kumar for Mayank Yadav in the bowling lineup.

item.title: Ladakh Women Halt Anti-Liquor Agitation Following Administration Deal
item.description: Sonam Wangchuk announced that female-led demonstrations in Ladakh opposing the new alcohol regulations have been halted. The suspension came after local authorities accepted all demands, including a full withdrawal of the policy and a total alcohol ban.

item.title: Supreme Court Appoints Sole Mediator in KG Basin Gas Dispute
item.description: The Supreme Court named retired Justice Ranjana Desai as the lone mediator for the dispute between the Centre and RIL. The government alleges RIL extracted gas from ONGC's adjoining blocks, a claim the company denies.

item.title: Mysuru Corporation Partners with India Post for Certificate Delivery
item.description: The Mysuru City Corporation and India Post established an agreement for nationwide postal delivery of birth and death certificates. Residents can utilize this doorstep service for a fee of 100 rupees.

item.title: India Bowls First After Changes; Smith Returns for New Zealand
item.description: India elected to bowl first, bringing in Kishan and Mayank while dropping Sooryavanshi and Bhuvneshwar. Meanwhile, New Zealand welcomed back Smith while leaving out Jamieson.

item.title: Tragedy Strikes Before December Wedding Ceremony for Young Couple
item.description: Twenty-four-year-old Jumratun Nessa Barsha passed away prior to her planned winter wedding celebration with Nabid Hossain. Although her parents initially opposed the romance, they later arranged a private kabin marriage ceremony for the pair.

item.title: Race Course IAF Station to Host Chief Handover Guard of Honour
item.description: For the first time, the Race Course Air Force Station will hold the guard of honour for outgoing and incoming chiefs. This development follows the recent October closure of the station's Air Force Sports Complex to members.

item.title: Arkansas Court Rules on Land Access Road Dispute
item.description: An Arkansas couple who spent 8,000 dollars for an 18-foot access road near Beaver Lake lost their location dispute. The state Court of Appeals upheld a pathway aligned with the neighbours' property boundary.

item.title: Vijayawada Election Staff Allowed Postal Voting Until October 30
item.description: Election officials in Vijayawada have until 5 p.m. on October 30 to cast their votes using postal ballots. Election Observer S. Nagalakshmi reviewed the setup at the Mogalrajpuram postal ballot centre.

item.title: German Teacher Faces Fraud Charges After 16-Year Sick Leave
item.description: A 62-year-old German instructor is facing fraud allegations after taking a 16-year medical leave. Authorities claim she received over 248,000 euros in salary during the absence by submitting fabricated medical records.

item.title: CPI(M) leader M.V. Govindan distances party from online trolling of Mammootty
item.description: M.V. Govindan stated that the CPI(M) has no connection to digital attacks on actor Mammootty. He noted that given the national recognition SFI and DYFI gained for their stance against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, there is no reason for the party to avoid the actor.

item.title: Hyrox competitor Joanna Wietrzyk addresses race incident and subsequent public criticism
item.description: In a BBC interview, Joanna Wietrzyk acknowledged her role in a hygiene incident during a competition that potentially impacted other participants. While taking responsibility for the event, she described the intense negative reaction she faced afterward as a traumatic experience.

item.title: পৃথিবীতে পানির উৎস নিয়ে বিজ্ঞানীদের মধ্যে বিতর্ক
item.description: পৃথিবীতে পানির আগমন নিয়ে গবেষকদের মধ্যে ভিন্ন মত রয়েছে। কেউ মনে করেন প্রাণের স্পন্দনের আগেই পানি ছিল, আবার কারও মতে গ্রহাণুর মাধ্যমে পানি পৃথিবীতে এসেছে।

item.title: Cyclone Arnab hits Odisha: Thousands relocated as damages reach ₹4,600 crore
item.description: Over 55,000 residents across nine districts in Odisha were evacuated due to the impact of Cyclone Arnab. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu reported that the severe storm caused infrastructure and economic losses totaling ₹4,600 crore.

item.title: PM Modi participates in roadshow during Gujarat visit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel and Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi, held a public procession in an open vehicle. The route spanned from the local helipad to the Banas Dairy facility.

item.title: ইসরায়েলে নির্বাচনের চূড়ান্ত ফল: সরকার গঠন নিয়ে অনিশ্চয়তা
item.description: শুক্রবার প্রকাশিত নির্বাচনের চূড়ান্ত ফলাফলে দেখা গেছে নেতানিয়াহুর জোট বা বিরোধী পক্ষ কেউই সংখ্যাগরিষ্ঠতা পায়নি। এই ফলাফলের ফলে দেশটিতে সরকার গঠন নিয়ে নতুন করে রাজনৈতিক অচলাবস্থা তৈরি হয়েছে।

item.title: Seeman suggests NTK may contest Ambasamudram by-election
item.description: NTK leader Seeman stated that his party will begin its election campaign in Palayamkottai on November 26. This date marks the birth anniversary of the deceased LTTE leader Velupillai Prabhakaran.

item.title: Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela to mobilize public support
item.description: After receiving her Nobel Prize and emerging from hiding, Maria Corina Machado has returned to Venezuela to organize social movements. She suggested that recent international pressure on the Maduro administration has created new opportunities for political change.

item.title: সরকারি আবাসন: ৩১ অক্টোবরের মধ্যে সাবলেট উচ্ছেদের নির্দেশ
item.description: সরকারি আবাসন পরিদপ্তর বরাদ্দপ্রাপ্ত কর্মচারীদের অবিলম্বে সাবলেট বা ভাড়াটেদের সরানোর তাগিদ দিয়েছে। ৩১ অক্টোবরের নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে আদেশ অমান্য করলে বরাদ্দ বাতিলের সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া হতে পারে। বরাদ্দকৃত বাসায় শুধু সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্মকর্তা-কর্মচারীকেই অবস্থান করতে বলা হয়েছে।

item.title: Bengaluru Metro Purple Line Delayed After Person Steps Onto Tracks at Indiranagar
item.description: Train operations along Bengaluru's Purple Line faced temporary interruptions following an incident where a traveler ventured onto the rails at Indiranagar station. The morning rush-hour delay impacted daily travelers on this route as well as those making train connections at Majestic.

item.title: প্রবারণা পূর্ণিমা: বাঁকখালী ও সাঙ্গু নদীতে ফানুস এবং কল্পজাহাজের উৎসব
item.description: পাহাড় ও নদীর সীমানায় ঐতিহ্যবাহী প্রবারণা পূর্ণিমা উদযাপিত হয়েছে। রামুর বাঁকখালী নদীতে রঙিন কল্পজাহাজ ভাসানোর পাশাপাশি সাঙ্গু নদে প্রদীপ জ্বালানো এবং আকাশে ফানুস উড়ানো হয়। ধর্মীয় এই আমেজ পারস্পরিক সম্প্রীতি ও আত্মশুদ্ধির বার্তা ছড়িয়ে দেয়।

item.title: ৩১ অক্টোবর ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে জাতীয় কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা অলিম্পিয়াড
item.description: আন্তর্জাতিক কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা অলিম্পিয়াডের দেশীয় নির্বাচন পর্ব অনুষ্ঠিত হতে যাচ্ছে আগামী ৩১ অক্টোবর। ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের তথ্যপ্রযুক্তি ইনস্টিটিউটে সকাল সাড়ে আটটা থেকে বিকাল তিনটা পর্যন্ত এই মেধা যাচাই প্রতিযোগিতা পরিচালিত হবে। উত্তীর্ণ প্রতিযোগীরা পরবর্তী আন্তর্জাতিক আসরে অংশগ্রহণের সুযোগ পাবেন।

item.title: নৈশভোজের জন্য নারকেলের হলুদ স্যুপ তৈরির প্রণালি
item.description: রাতের খাবারে রুটির সঙ্গে পরিবেশনের জন্য ভিন্নধর্মী হলুদ নারকেল স্যুপের প্রণালি জানিয়েছেন নাজিয়া ফারহানা। এটি তৈরিতে এক কাপ নারকেলের দুধের পাশাপাশি এক টেবিল চামচ অলিভ অয়েল, নির্দিষ্ট পরিমাণে পেঁয়াজ, রসুন ও আদা কুচি এবং আধা চা-চামচ হলুদগুঁড়া ব্যবহার করা হয়।

item.title: DMK Announces Oct 31 Protest; Stalin Questions Administration on Safety and Inflation
item.description: Criticizing current governance over deteriorating public safety and escalating costs of living, DMK chief Stalin confirmed plans for a demonstration on October 31. He questioned the leadership's oversight regarding law enforcement operations and performance evaluations.

item.title: Former Tamil Nadu Minister Anbil Sent to Judicial Custody
item.description: Chennai law enforcement detained the ex-School Education Minister following the denial of his anticipatory bail. He faces allegations tied to a massive financial extortion scheme targeting private school operators.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh Man Threatens Separation After Wife Declines Karwa Chauth Fast
item.description: A resident of Bijrawan village in Shivpuri district lodged a grievance after his spouse opted not to observe the Karwa Chauth ritual. Barelal Adivasi accused Mithilesh Adivasi of infidelity following her refusal, leading him to warn of ending their marriage.

item.title: ISRO Prepares NVS-03 Satellite Launch to Expand Indigenous NavIC System
item.description: India's space organization is advancing its regional positioning capability through the upcoming NVS-03 satellite mission. The initiative seeks to fortify the local NavIC network, diminishing reliance on foreign navigation services like GPS.

item.title: Delhi Police Outline Regulations for Upcoming Opposition Coalition Event
item.description: The INDIA alliance demonstration is scheduled at Ramlila Maidan, one of Delhi's three authorized protest locations following the de-notification of Jantar Mantar.

item.title: Congress urges central leadership in Cyclone Arnab relief
item.description: The opposition party called on the central administration to collaborate with regional authorities for prompt disaster recovery. Leaders also appealed for financial aid through the PM CARES fund and asked party members to aid impacted households.

item.title: Supreme Court orders former JD(U) lawmaker to surrender
item.description: The apex court instructed expelled legislator Anant Singh to turn himself in by December 1. Additionally, judges mandated that Bihar law enforcement finalize their probe within four months.

item.title: Mukteshwar estate maintains low capacity for guests
item.description: A family vacation property in the Kumaon hills of Uttarakhand operates exclusively with 12 rooms across 40 acres. The owner chose hospitality over growth after relocating from Mumbai in 1998, focusing on local staff and customized service.

item.title: Massive security deployment set for Delhi political rally
item.description: Authorities will deploy over 3,000 officers and 200 cameras at Ramlila Maidan for the November 1 INDIA bloc gathering. Meanwhile, local merchants asked organizers to delay the event due to potential holiday trade disruptions.

item.title: Madras High Court issues notice over PIL on Saurav Das
item.description: Judges responded to a public interest litigation requesting an investigation into Saurav Das's background and social media blocks following judicial criticism. The petition prompted public concern online regarding the situation.

item.title: Female workers break barriers at Telangana coal mines
item.description: Employees at the state-run Singareni Collieries Company are taking on roles traditionally held by men. These workers now manage explosives, fix heavy machinery, oversee subterranean tasks, and learn to operate massive dump trucks.

item.title: Syrians face steep costs amid post-Assad economic strain
item.description: Spiraling expenses and the removal of government subsidies are fueling public frustration. This economic pressure is presenting an early obstacle for Ahmed al-Sharaa's administration.

item.title: Daily sports trivia and quizzes now available
item.description: Readers can test their athletic expertise by participating in the daily Who Am I, Five in Five, and Brainteaser challenges.

item.title: PM Modi starts Gujarat tour, opens ₹325-crore breeding facility
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched a two-day trip to Gujarat by opening a ₹325-crore bovine breeding facility in Banaskantha. He is scheduled to head to Ekta Nagar for the Bharat Parv 2026 festival and a Narmada aarti.

item.title: প্রথম আলো ট্রাস্টের মাদকবিরোধী সহায়তা সভা অনুষ্ঠিত
item.description: প্রথম আলো ট্রাস্টের উদ্যোগে ২০২৫ সালের ২ আগস্ট কারওয়ান বাজার কার্যালয়ে ১৭১তম বিনা মূল্যের মাদকবিরোধী পরামর্শ সহায়তা সভা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে। সভায় শিশু বিকাশ এবং অভিভাবকদের করণীয় নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়।
